name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited during his teenage years, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts at his local track. This hands-on experience fueled his decision to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in precision manufacturing. After graduating, he secured a position as a junior quality control engineer at a small automotive firm before transitioning to Hot Racing Team. 

Alistair is meticulous and driven, with a keen eye for detail. He thrives on identifying potential flaws and implementing innovative solutions to enhance performance and reliability. His approach to quality control is holistic, considering not only the technical specifications but also the practical implications on the track. 

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to see the bigger picture. He's not just focused on individual components but on how they interact within the entire system. This visionary outlook, combined with his calm demeanor under pressure, makes him a valuable asset to the team, ensuring the highest standards of quality and performance are maintained.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, even when others are confident.
